heading: Coursework
intro: Course projects and academic work. Coursework is listed alongside the courses that produced it.

items.title: HiGrEC — Hierarchical Classification for Political Question Evasion
items.problem: Detecting when a political answer evades the question asked, over the QEvasion benchmark.
items.approach: Selected SemEval-2026 Task 6 (CLARITY) as the shared task and designed a hierarchical classification system over the QEvasion benchmark.
items.results: Shared task selected; system paper in preparation.
items.learned: How much a label hierarchy that mirrors the structure of the phenomenon buys you over flat classification on the same data.

items.title: Gyrocopter (Autogyro) Design and Testing
items.problem: Building and stabilising a free-spinning-rotor autogyro prototype, and sizing the rotor from first principles.
items.approach: Assembled a free-spinning-rotor autogyro prototype (fixed-wing fuselage, forward-thrust BLDC propulsion) and configured ArduPilot/ArduPlane firmware for stabilisation assistance. Performed aerodynamic analysis — blade element method and airfoil selection — in XFLR5 and derived flight dynamics calculations for rotor sizing and stability.
items.results: Working prototype with stabilisation-assisted firmware and an aerodynamic analysis supporting the rotor sizing.
items.learned: Autorotation is unforgiving of sloppy rotor sizing — the aerodynamics have to be right before the firmware matters.

items.title: Quadrotor Trajectory Planning and ROS Simulation
items.problem: Navigating a quadrotor through multiple waypoints, from desired acceleration down to attitude commands.
items.approach: Derived acceleration-to-attitude control mappings (thrust, roll, pitch commands) for multi-waypoint quadrotor navigation and simulated the resulting trajectories in ROS.
items.results: Simulated multi-waypoint trajectories in ROS from the derived control mappings.
items.learned: The mapping from a desired acceleration to an attitude command is where the aircraft's physical limits actually enter the planner.

items.title: Sequence Modeling: Cipher Decryption and Masked Language Modeling
items.problem: Building recurrent and state-space sequence models from scratch, without leaning on framework primitives.
items.approach: Built custom RNN/LSTM models (without nn.RNN or nn.LSTM) for character-level cipher decryption, and SSM/BiLSTM models for masked language modeling; logged experiments to WandB and published models to Hugging Face.
items.results: Working custom sequence models for both tasks, with experiment tracking and published model artefacts.
items.learned: Writing the recurrence by hand makes the gradient-flow problems that motivate gating impossible to ignore.

items.title: Transformer, CNN, and Optimization Study
items.problem: Isolating what architectural and optimiser choices actually contribute, rather than accepting defaults.
items.approach: Implemented a decoder-only Transformer comparing Pre-Norm and Post-Norm configurations, a CNN with Grad-CAM interpretability, and an optimiser/normalisation ablation study on CIFAR-10.
items.results: Comparative results across normalisation placement, optimiser choice, and normalisation strategy, with Grad-CAM attributions for the CNN.
items.learned: Pre-Norm versus Post-Norm is a training-stability decision long before it is an accuracy decision.
